faq.a: Fill out the enquiry form on our website or visit the school office. We'll schedule a campus tour and an interaction session. Admission is confirmed after document verification and fee payment.

faq.q: What curriculum does the school follow?
faq.a: We are affiliated to CBSE, New Delhi. Our curriculum blends the NCERT framework with smart-class technology and experiential learning.
Yes, we operate GPS-tracked school buses covering all major routes in Jayanagar, BTM Layout, JP Nagar and Koramangala.
We offer cricket, football, athletics, basketball, music, dance, art, drama, robotics club and quiz club. Inter-school competitions are held throughout the year.

faq.q: Are there remedial classes for struggling students?
faq.a: Yes, we provide free remedial sessions after school hours for students who need extra support in any subject.
